app.title: Nibnib: Image compression with extreme decompression speed
app.author: raphlinus
app.description: A high‑performance image compression library that achieves very fast decompression speeds while maintaining competitive compression ratios.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and run `cargo build` to build the library.
Run the provided `bench.rs` benchmark on a set of sample images and record compression ratio and decompression latency.
Compare the decompression latency to that of `zstd` and `jpegxl` on the same images.
Verify that the CLI `nibnib compress` command produces a valid image file that can be decoded by standard image viewers.
